Priya (docs): Heads-up, opened a small recipe PR: batching patterns + SDK examples (continuous batching, tenant cache hints, quant_profile guidance). PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

Kenji (eng-runtime): Nice. Quick Q: do we want to claim a specific % improvement? We should be conservative.

Priya (docs): I ran shortseq locally; saw ~12-18% token-cost reduction with kv-prefetch + quant_profile_v2. Thinking of: 'observed ~12-18% in internal shortseq harness; results vary by workload.' Thoughts?

Tom (sdk): I can add JS + Rust + Python snippets. For JS, streaming demonstrates prefix reuse; but maybe show single-response first.

Aisha (devex): Agreed: single-response main example, streaming appendix. I'll paste a tiny Python snippet for the docs test runner to pick up.

Aisha (devex): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model="rw-llama-2-13b",
  input="Translate to french: Hello world",
  batching={"max_batch_ms": 8},
  quant_profile="quant_profile_v2"
)
print(resp.output)
```

Priya (docs): Also drafting a short guidance line comparing quant_profile_v1 vs v2: 'v2 tends to reduce token-cost with batching or cache hits; v1 may give slightly lower p99 for ultra-low-latency single-shot flows on older kernels.' Kenji, ok?

Kenji (eng-runtime): That's fine; keep it high-level and avoid hard guarantees. If the harness diverges >5pp, use ranges and cite the harness config.

Tom (sdk): I'll note the opt-in env var in SDK v0.14: REDWOOD_PREFETCH=1 and add comments about max_batch_ms vs batch_size tradeoffs.

docs-bot: PR 789 updated by Priya. CI: docs-build passed.

Priya (docs): Two asks before merge: 1) runtime to sanity-check numbers against nightly harness; 2) devex to add snippet compile tests. Volunteers?

Kenji (eng-runtime): I'll run the harness tomorrow: ./tools/harness --profile shortseq --prefetch=on --quant=quant_profile_v2 -> output: ./out/shortseq-summary.json

Aisha (devex): I'll add unit tests that import the snippets into the docs test runner and push a tiny CI patch.

Priya (docs): Thanks — I'll hold the PR for those confirmations. If numbers differ, switch to 'ranges' phrasing and include harness command. I'll also add a note in the migration guide for customers pinning quant profiles.
